payload.core_mechanism_summary: Generate all strings in BFS order (by length, then lexicographically) and check if each is a substring of any input string; return the first non-substring.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over all strings in length-lexicographic order, which is a breadth-first traversal of the infinite tree of strings. It is a complete search over the string space, modeled as graph BFS.
